name: Flora-Bama Ole River Grill
description: The Flora-Bama Ole River Grill is the spot for relaxing waterfront dining with friends and family. This Orange Beach restaurant provides a casual atmosphere for any type group. Our unique menu provides the best of the coast and has a variety of seafood, steaks, po-boys, desserts and more. Throw in the large outdoor deck and the friendly smiles of the staff and you can see why Ole River Grill is a southern tradition. Located directly across the street from the Flora-Bama, Ole River Grill is a great place before or after your visit to the Bama. At the Flora-Bama Ole River Grill we pride ourselves in using fresh local seafood and locally grown ingredients. Our team takes the time to seek out area farms and seafood houses who believe in the same fresh standards. We also participate in the Oyster Shell Recycling Program because we strive to better our local environment. The program will recycle oyster shells from restaurants and get them back into Alabama waters, enhancing oyster production among other benefits. We are proud to offer local Isle Dauphine Oysters at all Flora-Bama locations. Sample one of the best southern delicacies.
